name: saas-ui-react
title: SaaS UI — React
description: Copy-in, user-owned React screens for the Lunora SaaS kit: the dashboard stat row, the project list with its create form and search/sort toolbar, the activity feed grouped by day, and the platform admin's organization, user and subscription tables — with suspend/unsuspend and impersonation on better-auth's `admin()` plugin. Framework-agnostic view model under lunora/saas-ui/core, thin React views under lunora/saas-ui/react, and token-aligned CSS — no Tailwind, no component library. Edit anything; upgrades are 3-way merged.
docs: Import the stylesheet once and render the cards from your dashboard route: `import { OverviewStats, ProjectsCard } from './lunora/saas-ui/react'; import './lunora/saas-ui/styles.css';`. Nothing here subscribes — the route owns the query, because the wiring differs per meta-framework. Pass `useQuery(api.saas.overview, {}, { shardKey: organizationId })` straight into `payload`, `Date.now()` into `now`, and your mutations, called with the same `shardKey`, into `onCreate`/`onArchive` — the `saas` functions run only on the organization's own shard. Requires the `saas` server item (auto-added). For sign-in and organization screens, add the matching `auth-ui-react` item. The admin user table and the impersonation banner talk to better-auth, not to a Lunora query: pass them `authClient.admin` from `createAuthClient({ plugins: [adminClient()] })`, mount `<ImpersonationBanner>` on every page (the admin queries refuse the impersonated user, so the admin screen cannot hold the way back), and navigate in `onSessionChange`. A suspension is a better-auth ban: it reaches new requests within the 60 s session cookie cache, and an already-open live connection only on its next reconnect.
